explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the foundation of everything, often mentioned in the chapter through Paul's testimony about his grace and truth.
The apostle who travels from Troas to Miletus to meet with the elders in Ephesus and give them his final exhortation before moving on.
The chosen leaders or overseers of the church, whom Paul warns about the dangers of false teachings and calls to care for the flock.
The community of believers that God has purchased with his own blood, and over which the elders are appointed to shepherd for God's kingdom.
False teachers or enemies from outside who will enter the church to lead the weak away from the truth.
God's undeserved favor and goodwill toward people, something Paul emphasizes that he has received and now shares further with the elders.
The pure gospel of Jesus Christ which stands in contrast to lies and false teachings that threaten the church.
The Holy Spirit who gives strength, guidance, and power to the apostles and believers to carry out God's will.
The work of serving the Lord Jesus Christ through preaching the gospel and caring for the weak in the congregation.
